# Tiering Fixture Candidates

## Words to avoid or examine

| Term | Repair | Gate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `synergy`, `synergies` | state the effect | FAIL |
| `in order to` | to | |
| `ensure*` | make sure, or name the check | WARN |
| `spin up`, `spins up` (literal: a test harness spins up a container) | start, or name the process | |
| `e.g.` | for example | |
